result.summary: This clip shows a free-kick from the left side of the attacking half, followed by a corner kick. The viewer is involved in the attacking movements in the box for both set pieces.

observations.title: Initial Position for Free-Kick
observations.body: The viewer, wearing white shirt number 10, is positioned near the penalty spot, slightly to the right of the goal, facing the ball as the free-kick is prepared.

observations.title: Defensive Wall and Box Setup
observations.body: The defending team forms a four-player wall. Several attacking players are positioned around the penalty area, some marking defenders, others looking for space.

observations.title: Free-Kick Taker
observations.body: A player in a white shirt, not the viewer, prepares to take the free-kick from the left wing, outside the penalty area.

observations.title: Free-Kick Delivery
observations.body: The free-kick is taken, with the ball lofted into the penalty area towards the far post.

observations.title: Movement Towards Far Post
observations.body: As the ball is delivered, the viewer (white #10) begins to move towards the far post, initially positioned behind a defender.

observations.title: First Contact in Box
observations.body: A white shirt player, not the viewer, heads the ball towards the center of the goal.

observations.title: Reacting to Bouncing Ball
observations.body: The ball bounces in the box. The viewer (white #10) is now in a central position, reacting to the bouncing ball while surrounded by defenders.

observations.title: Blocked Shot
observations.body: Another white shirt player, not the viewer, attempts a shot from close range, which is blocked by a defender. The viewer is nearby but not directly involved in the shot.

observations.title: Corner Awarded
observations.body: The ball deflects off the defender and goes out of play, resulting in a corner kick.

observations.title: Preparing for Corner
observations.body: The viewer (white #10) walks towards the corner flag, indicating preparation for the subsequent corner kick.

observations.title: Corner Kick Delivery
observations.body: The corner kick is taken, with the ball delivered high into the penalty box.

observations.title: Attempted Header
observations.body: The viewer (white #10) is positioned near the penalty spot, attempting to get on the end of the cross, but a defender clears the ball.
